cohort: 529 single-term newborns in a tertiary hospital with the Baby-Friendly Hospital Initiative (BFHI) award
finding: Several risk factors are associated with the premature cessation of exclusive breastfeeding, including pacifier use, cesarean delivery, no college degree, not attending breastfeeding support groups, reintegration into the workplace, and primiparity.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with cessation of exclusive breastfeeding at 3 months (OR 4.49; 95% CI 2.96-6.83).
